title: Field-level weak lensing cosmology with $60$ simulations using multifidelity simulation-based inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.23346v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We perform a realistic KiDS-Legacy mock analysis with field-level neural compression and simulation-based inference using just 60 $N$-body simulations. The weak lensing shear field encodes substantially more cosmological information than standard two-point summary statistics such as the power spectrum. Field-level inference can fully exploit this information, but physical realism at the field-level requires very high-fidelity simulations. This poses a major challenge for simulation-based inference (SBI): accurate empirical density modelling and deep-learning-based neural compression require tens of thousands of training samples, but achieving physical realism at the field level makes each simulation extremely costly. We demonstrate that multifidelity SBI can alleviate this tension by substantially reducing the number of high-fidelity simulations needed for accurate cosmological inference. translated_title: 使用多保真度基于模拟的推断方法，仅用60次模拟进行场级弱引力透镜宇宙学研究
translated_abstract: 我们使用场级神经压缩和基于模拟的推断方法，仅通过60次N体模拟进行了真实的KiDS-Legacy模拟分析。弱引力透镜剪切场编码的宇宙学信息远多于标准二点统计量（如功率谱）。场级推断可以充分利用这些信息，但场级的物理真实性需要非常高保真度的模拟。这给基于模拟的推断（SBI）带来了重大挑战：准确的经验密度建模和基于深度学习的神经压缩需要数万个训练样本，但在场级实现物理真实性使得每次模拟的成本极其高昂。我们证明了多保真度SBI可以通过大幅减少准确宇宙学推断所需的高保真度模拟数量来缓解这一矛盾。我们在低保真度模拟上预训练神经推断模型……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该研究证明多保真度基于模拟的推断方法可将准确的场级弱引力透镜宇宙学推断所需的高保真度N体模拟数量减少至仅60次，从而在保持物理真实性的同时大幅降低计算成本。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that multifidelity simulation-based inference can reduce the number of high-fidelity N-body simulations needed for accurate field-level weak lensing cosmology to just 60, substantially lowering computational costs while maintaining physical realism.
